state: Sellers drive price lower with a sharp 19-unit extension, breaking the 29704.0 low.
paragraphs: Sellers have seized immediate control of the market by pushing price down to 29184.0, breaking through the latest confirmed low at 29704.0 with sharp acceleration. The latest downside extension reached a 19-unit run, completely overshadowing the size of recent counter-moves and driving price below the middle Bollinger band located at 29566.0. While the confirmed swing structure shows prior higher highs and higher lows, the current sequence exhibits high timing consistency and low opposing wick pressure, confirming that the downward pressure is forceful. This break does not yet form a clean, stable downtrend across the wider sample, but the immediate advantage rests firmly with the downside extension as price rides the lower Bollinger boundary.

Looking across the broader history, the underlying sample shows a market balancing between quiet disorder and sudden downside weight. Over the entire 104-brick window, bearish runs average 4.86 units while bullish counters manage just 2.57. Recent behavior highlights an escalation in that imbalance. In the latest 12 runs, average downward extensions reached 5.0 units and culminated in a 19-unit drop, while bullish counter-moves grew to an average of 3.67 units. This reveals that while counter-moves are attempting to gain traction, sellers maintain superior persistence. Selling pressure has outpaced buying attempts in both frequency and scale, shifting the character of the decline from standard churn into a much heavier impulsive phase without altering the wider transitional state.

The current drop carries strong momentum, but that force is developing inside an unstable structural background. Low opposing wick pressure and high timing consistency confirm that sellers are maintaining disciplined pressure as price rides the lower volatility boundary at 29097.82909. At the same time, compression remains minimal, showing that the decline is expanding openly instead of tightening into a narrow channel. Yet, because the wider transition reading stays elevated and chop is absent, the downward thrust reflects a mature correction phase instead of a settled structural overhaul. Sellers hold clear immediate advantage through high continuation scores, but the lack of underlying stability means the move relies entirely on uninterrupted selling pressure to maintain its authority.

Immediate support rests at the lower Bollinger boundary of 29097.82909, which sits right alongside the harmonic completion point at 29184.0 where price currently trades. Just above this zone, the falling regression line at 29327.6132 and SAR at 29407.35164 form the first cluster of overhead resistance. The broken swing low at 29704.0 adds further resistance higher up. Because price has already pushed past several confirmed low pivots in this drop, these overhead levels define where selling pressure must be absorbed if a sustained recovery is to take shape. For now, the close proximity of SAR and the regression line keeps immediate control tilted toward the downside.

The persistent downside run finds ongoing room to expand inside a very broad volatility envelope, though the expanding width reflects prior movement instead of fresh acceleration building behind the current drop. Low opposing wick pressure shows that buyers are failing to mount meaningful rejections against the decline. At the same time, a developing Deep Crab harmonic pattern sits directly at the 29184.0 price location. This pattern introduces counter-pressure to the market without confirming a reversal by itself. The current downward extension can continue as long as sellers maintain their timing consistency, but any failure to push past the lower Bollinger boundary at 29097.82909 will test whether the harmonic zone can stall the move.

Rapid switching, erratic timing, frequent reversals, and general disorder keep the broader market unresolved. That unsettled state fades only when price action settles into greater regularity, whether through a stable range or sustained directional persistence. The current bearish lean becomes more convincing only when instability decreases and sellers deliver repeated downside runs with steady timing, coherent pace, and continued structural progress. That downside bias becomes weaker if buyers manage to reclaim broken structure like the level at 29704.0, launch longer counter-runs, or disrupt the timing consistency that currently favors the decline. Until one of those shifts occurs, the market retains its downward correction lean without locking into a clean, permanent trend.
